## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or operational contract this changes.

## Verification

- [ ] Lint, typecheck, tests, and builds pass
- [ ] Compose/configuration gates relevant to this change pass

- [ ] Visual changes include desktop/mobile evidence and independent critique

changes, or manual deployment steps. Never paste secret values.
